page.layout: One page of text in a single column; a decorative rule divides the verse above from the heading below; marginal notes in the right margin (Dionysius, Phanagora, Hermonassa oppidum, Martialis lib.1 with numbered notes 1–6, Sidonius Apollinaris carmin. VII). Running head at top; page number at top right.

main_text.p: Sed iacet aegeribus niveis informis, & alto Dionysius.
Terga gelu late, septemque assurgit in ulnas.
Cimmerium vero ibi per Bosporum recta eunti Phanagora.
Alia immensa insula est, quae quidem paludem Hermonassa oppidum,
Intra Mæotidem sita est (ad dexteram)
Quum super Phanagoráque, & bene constructa Hermonassi,
Vbi habitant qui Ionica sunt oriundi a terra.
main_text.head: VISVM EST PRO CORONI- de horum librorū, duo quaedam addere: Primum, quae fuerint miracula seu opera in toto terrarum orbe celebriora. Fuerunt autem sex ista.
main_text.p: Martialis lib.1.Barbara Pyramidum sileat miracula Memphis: 1 Pyramides Ægyptiæ.
Assiduus iactet nec Babylona labor: 2 Babylon civitas.
Nec Triuia templo molles laudentur honores: 3 Templum Ephesiæ Dianæ.
Dissimulétque Deum cornibus ara frequens: 4 Templum Iovis Ammonis.
Aere nec vacuo pendentia Mausolea 5 Mausoleum sepulchrum in Caria.
Laudibus immodicis Cares in astra ferant: 6 Amphitheatrum à Cæsare Domitiano extructum.
Omnis Cæsareo cedat labor Amphitheatro, Sidonius Apollinar. carmin. VII.
Vnum pro cunctis fama loquatur opus.
Secundùm, quid singulare quaeque regio habeat, vnde celebrior sit.
— Aduolat omnis
Terra simul: tum quaeque suos provincia fructus
Exposuit, fert Indus ebur: Chaldaeus amomum:
Assyrius gemmas: Ser vellera: thura Sabaeus:

page.notes: Woodcut-style decorative band between verse and heading. Marginal note letters in the right margin are reproduced as printed. A mark "X" appears at the foot of the page as a printed ornament. Some words in the verse are uncertain due to ink and show-through; "Aerè" and "Sidonius" readings are approximate.
